message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a red rectangular block at the top. Below, three men sit on the top rim of a large, green cylindrical object resembling a gas tank. The man on the left wears a light-colored shirt and black pants, touching his head with one hand. The center man wears a light shirt and tan pants, resting his hands on his lap. The man on the right wears a light shirt and black pants, holding his hands out in a questioning gesture.

The green cylinder features a pressure regulator on top with a black hose and a gauge displaying a red needle in a low zone. Bold white text on the left reads: "MINYAK HILANG ELPIJI TAK TERBILANG". Smaller text below mentions "Blokade Selat Hormuz," "perang Iran-Israel," and "Indonesia seret." 

Top headlines include "Dua Kaki PDI Perjuangan H.26" and "Suap Haji Mengalir Jauh H.68". At the bottom, a barcode, a QR code, and text stating "6-12 APRIL 2026," "RP 60.000," and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN" are visible. The background is a muted olive green.
